text:
maria: Heads up — noticed a spike in GH Actions eval runs this morning, lots of duplicate runner starts when the nightly cron overlaps a PR matrix. seeing ~6 simultaneous jobs for the same eval shard.

devon: yeah saw that too. PR gating timed out on two PRs. logs show repeated `runner self-hosted` registrations then immediate cancel.

sasha: @maria can you paste the workflow snippet? suspect concurrency/group not set.

maria: here's the relevant part from .github/workflows/evals.yml: ```yaml
on:
  push: {}
  pull_request: {}
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 3 * * *' # nightly
jobs:
  eval-matrix:
    runs-on: [self-hosted, gpu]
    strategy:
      matrix:
        model: [m1, m2, m3]
        quant: [fp16, int8]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - run: ./scripts/run-eval.sh
```

oliver: missing `concurrency` block. add `concurrency: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ matrix.model }}-${{ github.ref }}` or even lock per shard id so cron vs PR don't collide.

devon: FYI the runner logs had repeated: ```
INFO: registering runner id=xxx
INFO: job received: eval-matrix (matrix index 2)
WARN: duplicate job claim, shutting down
```

ci-bot: [system] 5 jobs queued, 3 canceled due to duplicate group constraint (simulated).

jing: Another angle — our artifact uploader is throttling S3 which prolongs job runtime and makes overlap worse. We should drop large debug artifacts for nightly or change to incremental upload.

maria: good point. maybe only upload `metrics.json` and stdout for PRs, full artifacts for nightly. small change: `if: github.event_name == 'schedule'` to gate the heavy uploads.

sasha: also propose a lightweight dispatcher job: single small job that fans out to Buildkite or our runner pool via API instead of GH Actions creating many heavy self-hosted runners. keep GH run minimal to enqueue tasks.

oliver: that would also let us rate-limit at the dispatcher layer. we can enforce concurrency tokens per customer/model.

devon: quick patch I tested locally: add `concurrency:` plus `cancel-in-progress: true` and reduce matrix shard count for PR runs using `if: github.ref != 'refs/heads/main'` for full matrix. simple diff: ```yaml
concurrency:
  group: eval-${{ matrix.model }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true
```

maria: pushed a PR with those changes + artifact filter. will monitor tonight cron. thanks all. :rocket: 

jing: if the overlap persists, I'll add a short-lived DB lock to the eval runner to detect duplicates and exit gracefully (with an event to Sentry).

maria: sounds good. follow-up: add a small dashboard tile in Redwood Console to show concurrent eval counts per hour so we can see burst pattern.

devon: noted — I'll add a Grafana panel and a GH Actions metric export.

maria: closing for now, will reopen if we still see duplicate runner churn. (reaction :eyes:)
